objective: Fix the bug(s) in Truncate in internal/textutil/textutil.go without changing PadLeft or CountWords. Required behavior: if max <= 0 return ""; if s has at most max runes (not bytes) return s unchanged; otherwise, if max <= 3 return the first max runes with no ellipsis; otherwise return the first max-3 runes followed by "..." (the result is exactly max runes long). It must never split a multi-byte character or panic.
acceptanceCriteria: PadLeft and CountWords behave exactly as before
